title: Player-Reporter
description: Player-Reporter Plugin for Minecraft. Easy, fast and tuff!
body:
# About the Plugin
A powerful and easy-to-use player reporting system designed for Minecraft servers This plugin allows players to quickly report rule breakers, suspicious activity, harassment, cheating, and other violations directly in-game, helping staff respond to issues more efficiently.

Reports are organized in a clean and manageable system, giving moderators and administrators the tools they need to review, track, and resolve cases. Staff can view report details, monitor report status, and manage reports without relying on external tools or complicated workflows.

## Key Features:
• Simple and intuitive player reporting commands.
• Real-time staff notifications when new reports are submitted.
• Organized report management system.
• Permission-based access for moderators and administrators.
• Support for report reasons and additional information.
• Easy review and handling of pending reports.
• Lightweight and optimized for performance.
• Configurable messages and settings.
• Designed for Paper, Spigot, and compatible server software.
• Seamless integration into existing moderation workflows.

### Commands
```
/report <player> <reason> report a Player for an valid reason

/reports lists all reports

/reportundo <player> removes the reports from an Player

```

### Details:
Whether you're running a small community server or a large network, this plugin helps improve moderation efficiency by providing a reliable and structured way for players to report problems and for staff to take action. Keep your server safer, reduce response times, and give your community a direct line of communication with your moderation team through a modern reporting system built for Minecraft servers.
